requirements.evidence: .env.example:1,7 sets APP_NAME=PegaFila/APP_LOCALE=pt_BR; phpunit.xml:22-24 pins the three env values; config/mail.php:131-136 sets 'markdown' => ['theme' => 'pegafila']; pegafila.css:242-247 puts #0f7490 on .button-primary (present in every action mail); lang/pt_BR.json:559,804 adds "Reset your password" and "Verify your email address"; routes/web.php:16-32 define all five named routes with guest, throttle:6,1 and auth+signed+throttle; PasswordResetLinkController.php:29-35 always returns back()->with('status', __('passwords.sent')); NewPasswordController.php:33-58 validates min(8)->letters()->mixedCase()->numbers() + confirmed, rotates remember_token, fires PasswordReset, redirects to '/'; VerifyEmailController.php:22-32 aborts 403 unless id and sha1(email) match, redirects to '/'; reset view has a single e-mail input.

conventions.evidence: Test-first Pest suite and CHANGELOG entry under Added (CHANGELOG.md:15) follow conventions; PHPDoc on public methods. Deviation: NewPasswordController.php:33-37 validates three fields inline although conventions call for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields. The two auth views duplicate the full <head>/Bulma bootstrap instead of sharing markup (layouts are out of scope, so this is minor).

security.evidence: No enumeration on password.email: response identical for existing/unknown/throttled addresses (PasswordResetLinkController.php:33-35); reset requires token+email+strong password; remember_token rotated (NewPasswordController.php:46-49); verification uses hash_equals on id and hash behind auth+signed+throttle (VerifyEmailController.php:22-26, routes/web.php:30-32); all Blade output uses {{ }} escaping; forceFill limited to password/remember_token. Only nit: failed reset echoes the broker status (e.g. passwords.user), standard Laravel behaviour behind a valid token.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php covers config pins (:18-23), reset mail subject/brand/greeting/button/body/colour and absence of 'having trouble clicking' (:25-33), verification mail (:35-42), guest-only form (:44-47), enumeration-safe send for existing/unknown/invalid e-mails (:49-63), reset success incl. remember_token rotation and PasswordReset event (:72-88), bad token/weak/unconfirmed passwords (:90-110), verification success and 403 on wrong id/hash/unsigned (:112-137). Gaps: no assertion of the throttle middleware, no feature test asserting accessible labels on the form views, no Verified event assertion.

simplicity.evidence: Controllers are lean and reuse Laravel's Password broker and notifications rather than custom logic. The 297-line pegafila.css is a full copy of the default theme, which is needed since a custom theme replaces default.css. The two views duplicate the same head/Vite/CDN fallback block (forgot-password.blade.php:1-16, reset-password.blade.php:1-16).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with clear PHPDoc (PasswordResetLinkController.php:20-26 explains the non-disclosure rationale); comment on the '/' redirect (NewPasswordController.php:57); descriptive test names; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Diff touches only .env.example, phpunit.xml, config/mail.php, lang/pt_BR.json, the theme, the two required views, three controllers, routes, tests and CHANGELOG; no login/registration/notice/resend endpoints, Livewire, layouts, ui.php, Docker or SCSS changes.

issues.explanation: Three-field validation is inline although the conventions ask for a Form Request once rules exceed one or two fields.
No test asserts the throttle:6,1 rate limit on password.email or the Verified event on verification.
View tests do not assert accessible labels/key markup as the UI conventions ask (only status and input values).
The full HTML head with Vite/CDN fallback is duplicated across both auth views.
On failure the broker status (e.g. passwords.user) is shown, which can reveal whether an e-mail exists to someone holding a token; standard Laravel behaviour, low impact.

review.summary: The change ships the pt-BR locale/name pins, the pegafila mail theme with #0f7490 on the action button, the two missing lang entries, the guest password-reset flow with an enumeration-safe link request, and the signed verification route, all covered by a solid Pest feature test file. Remaining points are minor: inline validation where a Form Request is expected, duplicated view heads, and a few untested details (throttle, Verified event, accessible labels), so it is approvable with nits.
